title: Celestial Witches Ritual
description: Four hooded witches with glowing butterfly wings stand on a stone platform holding hands in a circle under a large cracked celestial moon dripping golden liquid. Ancient ruined arches float above misty waters while a gnarled cliff with glowing blue flora rises on the left under a smaller full moon.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene at night with four hooded witches wearing colorful robes and large glowing butterfly wings standing in a circle holding hands on a stone platform. They perform a ritual under a giant cracked purple moon that drips golden liquid and musical notes. Ancient broken gothic arches float in the misty background, a tall dark cliff covered in glowing blue flowers and vines on the left, smaller full moon in the stormy sky, magical sparkles and ravens, dark fantasy atmosphere.
